# R407 v2 addendum — phase-specific capacity and corrected prompt rows

Date: 2026-10-13 (Asia/Tokyo). This addendum corrects the candidate grid and applicability of the free-memory arithmetic in R407 v1. V1 is unchanged (SHA-256 `124d0ad8d1982471401a0636e4cbfac6f37ff06b1366284a4615d6220a0aa9a4`). Only this report was written. No source, test, build, lint, GPU, process, service, profiler, Git, or cleanup action was performed. Main's serialized P build/lint sequence and its 18 pinned source changes were not touched.

## Corrections

1. The two fresh-free samples in the L receipt were observed during its phase-0 arrangement with workspace/session and decode-cache/head owners retained. Their arithmetic residual after subtracting the L layer-cache and reserve is 358,121,472 B and 136,699,904 B. This is only L-specific accounting. In P's full physical lease, the full decode cache and head are released and the workspace is reinitialized before the fresh query. The L numbers therefore establish neither P admission nor P refusal. Do not carry the L subtraction forward as a P measurement or use it as the P prefix bound. The required P bound is the fresh VRAM/RAM sample recorded after the P lease, workspace reinitialization, and its actual owners, followed by the actual cache/bridge allocation outcome. Keep reserve fixed; do not auto-shrink it.

2. Prompt length and Prefill span differ for these comparisons. A 32768-token request reaches Prefill as 32767 rows. With chunk 8192, that is three full chunks and one 8191-row final chunk (four chunks total). `R_GPU=8192` places the first full chunk on device and leaves 24575 host rows: two full 8192-row tails and one 8191-row tail (three host-tail chunks), not seven.

3. The unchanged official `bench.sh --long --runs 3` workload's actual stock client prompt is 32049 tokens; Prefill receives 32048 rows. At chunk 8192 that is three full chunks plus a 7472-row final chunk (four total). With `R_GPU=8192`, the host tail is 23856 rows: two full chunks and one 7472-row tail (three host-tail chunks). Thus the proposed 32768 prompt is a capacity diagnostic unless the stock client actually issues that prompt. It must not be described as the unchanged benchmark prompt. Any speed comparison must keep the stock command and its 32049-token request unchanged.

## Revised next-run interpretation

The smallest positive-prefix capacity diagnostic remains a 32768-token request / 32767-row Prefill with `R_GPU=8192`, but it is only a diagnostic and can run only if P's own post-lease fresh admission and actual 335,544,320-byte residual-prefix allocation pass with cache and the full 734,003,200-byte reserve. Record P's free/total VRAM and available RAM after the lease/workspace sequence; record planned bytes and actual allocation result. A failure is a refusal result. Do not infer the result from L's free samples or lower the reserve.

The next distinct row-count point, if the diagnostic succeeds, is the unchanged official stock benchmark prompt of 32049 request tokens / 32048 Prefill rows with `R_GPU=8192`; its host tail is exactly 23856 rows. Use only `bench.sh --long --runs 3` and unchanged official workload when collecting performance. Do not first run 65536 or 262144 as if they were the next stock settings; they are separate capacity/stress probes and need their own authorization/admission schedule.

The static planner edge results in v1 remain: a 32767-row Prefill with requested prefix 32768 selects all 32767 rows due to the exact-full-request case; 65535 with 65536 selects all 65535; 262144 with 262144 requests all 10 GiB. Those calculations explain requested extents only. Whether P admits any case must come from its own fresh query and actual allocator outcomes.

## Remaining evidence gap

L's `R_GPU=0` receipt validates only the all-RAM prefix on its recorded lifecycle. It gives no positive-prefix allocation, P phase-lease free-memory sample, or performance evidence. For P, capture the `ADMITTED` record or exact refusal from the post-lease fresh query, requested and planned/effective prefix rows, host-tail rows, bridge/cache/reserve extents, allocation outcome, completed per-chunk copy payload, progress, final result, and drain status. This distinguishes planner arithmetic from physical fit and proves what layout actually ran.
qualification: Source-only report. Main executed evidence is separate; R412 audited parent only, superseded for actual4K source by R413. R413 says five but explicitly lists six changed files.
